WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.SchoolName,

    AND s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
    AND s.GSoffered = 'K-12'
    AND s.GSserved = 'K-12'

  FROM 
    filtered_data
)

JOIN

WITH race_info AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.date,
    r.time
  FROM
    races r
  WHERE
    r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND r.year = 2008
),
champion_info AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    d.driverId,
    d.surname,
    d.nationality,
    res.position,
    res.time AS champion_time
  FROM
    races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE
    r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND r.year = 2008
    AND res.position = 1
),
last_driver_info AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    d.driverId,
    d.surname,
    d.nationality,
    res.position,
    res.time AS last_driver_time
  FROM
    races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE
    r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
    AND r.year = 2008
    AND res.position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM results WHERE raceId = r.raceId)
)
SELECT
  (CAST((julianday(l.last_driver_time) - julianday(c.champion_time)) AS REAL) * 100) / julianday(l.last_driver_time) AS percentage_difference
FROM
  champion_info c
  JOIN last_driver_info l ON c.raceId = l.raceId;
